newsitem.title: USA: Greenway sees value in proposed Inland spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Greenway sees value in proposed Inland spinoff.

text.p: Greenway Partners LP said Friday its proposed spinoff of Inland Steel Industries Inc's Ryerson Tull unit will increase Inland shareholder value and far outweigh any tax cost.
Greenway, an Inland shareholder, has proposed Inland spin off its remaining 87 percent stake in Ryerson. Inland completed an initial public offering of Ryerson last year.

The Inland board has recommended against the proposal. And, in a May 15 letter, Indland said Institutional Shareholder Services also recommended that shareholders vote against it at the company's May 28 meeting. ISS is a consulting firm that advises institutional investors.
"Your letter of May 15, 1997 seriously misstates the position of Greenway Partners LP," Greenway said in a letter responding to Inland.

"We believe the implementation of our spin-off proposal...will result in a significant increase in shareholder value," Greenway said. "Such increase will far outweigh any tax cost, which we -- and others -- believe to be minimal."
